data.name: Khushbakht
data.gender_notes: Khushbakht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Persian origin meaning 'bringer of joy' or 'contentment'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the happiness and peace that comes from following God's will. The name Khushbakht carries the meaning “Joy, Contentment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khushbakht usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, contentment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the joy and peace that comes from a close relationship with Allah.
data.etymology: Khushbakht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joy, Contentment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khushbakht total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
